gramlot-py-server 0.2.2 adds the command `gramlot`, which creates a project and serves the example gallery with each of the five adapters, and aligns the adapters with the page modules of the Gramlot core 0.2.5. It requires `gramlot>=0.2.5`.

## The gramlot command

The form is environment first, then verb: `gramlot <environment> <verb>`, with the environments `uvicorn`, `django`, `flask`, `fastapi` and `kajenn`.

```sh
python -m pip install "gramlot-py-server[django]"
gramlot django new my-site
cd my-site
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
django-admin runserver --settings=settings --pythonpath=.
```

- `gramlot <environment> new <folder>` writes the quick start of the README: the files of the framework, `requirements.txt` with the extra, the page `pages/index.py` and its page module `pages/index.js`, which exports `Logic`. The page has no inline code; the project sends the strict Content Security Policy profile. Every project starts on port 8000, Flask included (`flask --app app run --port 8000`).
- `gramlot <environment> gallery` serves the example gallery of `gramlot-examples` with the adapter of the environment: the common families and the family of the environment, whose example is the quick start. Options: `--host`, `--port` (8080), `--mount` (no prefix by default), `--catalog CATALOG PAGES`. It needs the new extra `gallery`, which installs `gramlot-examples>=0.2.5`.
- Each environment is an entry point of the group `gramlot_py_server.commands`; only the chosen one is imported.

## Changes in the five adapters

- **Page modules.** GET and HEAD serve the `.css` and `.js` files below the pages folder (until 0.2.1: `.css` and `_aux.js`), so a page `foo.py` takes its `Logic` from `foo.js` beside it (core GC-090 §030).
- **Core themes.** `/themes/…` serves the files of the themes folder of the core, with the media type of their extension: `Page.css = ["/themes/gramlot-base/theme.css"]` works without other settings.
- **Assets.** The option `assets` serves a map of URLs below the mount path to files, the form that `build_gallery` of `gramlot-examples` returns.
- **Mount path.** The prefix without the final slash, `/py`, answers 301 to `/py/`. Django gains `Pages.urlpatterns`, which includes `Pages.urls` at the mount path with that redirect. Kajenn accepts an empty `mount`, the site root.
- **`serve()`.** Each adapter module has `serve(pages, *, host, port, **options)`, which runs the server of its framework.

## Incompatible change: Uvicorn behind a proxy

With `mount_path` the Uvicorn application now expects the prefix in the request path, as the Django, Flask and FastAPI adapters do, and answers 404 outside it. A proxy must pass the path unchanged: with nginx, `proxy_pass` without a URI (`proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000;`). A proxy that removes the prefix makes every request answer 404.

## Other changes

- The documentation uses the vector logo of the core kit; the sdist goes from 1.2 MB to 80 KB.
- `examples/django`, `flask`, `fastapi` and `kajenn` are removed: the templates of `gramlot new` replace them. `examples/pages` and `examples/uvicorn` remain for the Uvicorn tutorial.
- New guide GP-020, The gramlot command.
- CI runs the adapters and the gallery of every environment in Chromium, and a clean install of each environment from the built wheel.
